dedupe_keys.name: citygml utility network ade application domain extension

description: The CityGML Utility Network ADE is a data model extending the CityGML standard to represent supply and disposal networks, such as electricity, gas, district heating, telecommunication, freshwater and wastewater, within one framework linked to 3D city models. It offers dual topographic and topological representation, hierarchical modelling of components and networks, links between different network types and to city objects, and functional concepts such as supply areas, organised in five modules: network core, network components, feature material, network properties and functional characteristics. It was first developed in 2009 to 2012 at TU Berlin in the SIMKAS 3D project on cascading failures of critical infrastructures and has been revised at the Technical University of Munich since 2015. The UML model, XML schemas, code lists, ShapeChange configuration and FME feature types are available free on GitHub under the Apache 2.0 licence, with a CityGML 2.0 version and a CityGML 3.0 draft. Caveats: the CityGML 3.0 version is marked as a first draft that may change, and sample datasets exist only for the 2.0 version. It supports building integrated multi-utility network models for interdependency and cascading failure simulation; a related record is the I2Sim infrastructure interdependencies simulator.
